senses.gloss: to gather, glean; to pick, v. Pi.—Part. לוֹקֵט gleaner, huckster, v. לָקוֹט.

units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 26a:26">M. Kat. 26ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ללוֹקְטָן ולעשותן כמין סולמות</he> to mend (the rents for the dead) by gathering or making a sort of stairs (chain-stitches), v. <cite ref="O00321"><he>סוּלָּם</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to pick, harvest; to pick up, collect.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 4:21">Tosef. Shebi. IV, 21</cite> <he>לי׳ אתרוג באחד וכ׳</he> he harvested Ethrogs on the first of Sh’bat; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 14a">R. Hash. 14ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 7a">Erub. 7ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 15a">Yeb. 15ᵃ</cite>. Tosef.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:9">R. Hash. I, 9</cite> <he>לי׳ ירק</he> if one picked vegetables; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 2:5">Maas. Sh. II, 5</cite> <he>מה שלי׳ לי׳ וכ׳</he> Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. <he>מה שלקט לקט</he>) what coins he picked up singly belong to the second-tithe fund. Y. ib. 53ᶜ <he>והוא שלי׳ מיכן ומיכן אבל לי׳ על אומד וכ׳</he> (not <he>אומן</he>) provided he picked up here and there (deliberately selecting), but if he did so at random &c.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 7b:20">Bekh. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>כל המטיל בצים מְלַקֵּט וכ׳</he> every animal that lays eggs supports its brood by picking up food for it, except the bat … which gives suck.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:5">M. Kat. I, 5</cite> <he>מלקט אדם וכ׳</he> one may (during the festive week) collect for final burial the bones of &c., v. <cite ref="L00520"><he>לִיקּוּט</he></cite>.
Snh. VI, 6 מְלַקְּטִין את העצמות וכ׳ the bones (of the convict) may be collected and buried in their family tomb; a. fr.—Esp. to glean, to take the poor man’s share in the crop.

<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 4:9">Peah IV, 9</cite> <he>מי שלקט וכ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>שלי׳</he>) if one gleaned the corner of the field and said, this is to belong to &c.; <cite ref="Gittin 11b">Gitt. 11ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 9b">B. Mets. 9ᵇ</cite>.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 5:6">Peah V, 6</cite> <he>לִלְקוֹט</he> (Y. ed. <he>ללַקֵּט</he>). Y. ib. IV, 18ᵇ <he>ילכו וִילַקְּטוּ וכ׳</he> let them have an opportunity to go and glean in another field &c., v. <cite ref="K00538"><he>כִּילּוּי</he></cite>, a. v. fr.—[<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 4:5">Peah IV, 5</cite>, v. Hif.].—[<cite ref="Sotah 11b:7">Sot. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>ומלקט להן וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N01190"><he>נָקַט</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Nazir 40b:7">Naz. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>לִיקְּטוֹ במלקט</he> if he plucked it singly with pinchers; <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:5">Macc. III, 5</cite> <he>לְקָטוֹ</he>.

<cite ref="Makkot 20b:5">Ib. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>במְלַקֵּט לבנות וכ׳</he> when one plucks out the white hair among the black; <cite ref="Shabbat 94b">Sabb. 94ᵇ</cite>; a. e.—[Naz. l. c. <he>עד שילקטנו בתער</he>, read <he>שיטלנו</he> as <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:5">Macc. III, 5</cite>.]

<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 4:21">Tosef. Shebi. IV, 21</cite> <he>שגדל בחובה ונ׳ בחובה</he> what has been growing under obligation (as eventually subject to tithes) and been harvested under obligation; <he>שגדל בשביעית ונ׳ בשביעית</he> what has been growing in the Sabbatical year and collected in &c.; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 15a">R. Hash. 15ᵃ</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 5:1">Peah V, 1</cite> <he>גדיש שלא ל׳ תחתיו</he> a stack of grain under which the gleaning for the poor has been left.

senses.gloss: to cause picking, to strew feed for birds.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 18:4">Tosef. Sabb. XVIII, 4</cite> <he>מַלְקִיטִין</he>, contrad. to <he>מהלקטין</he> (v. <cite ref="E00411"><he>הִילְקט</he></cite>); <cite ref="Shabbat 155b">Sabb. 155ᵇ</cite>

senses.gloss: to arrange the gleaning by the poor.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 4:5">Peah IV, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 4:3">3</cite>) <he>היו מַלְקִיטִין על החבל</he> Y. ed. (Bab. ed. a. Mish. <he>מלקטין</he>) arranged the gleaning by the line, leaving a corner at the end of each furrow.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 2:5">Maas. Sh. II, 5</cite> <he>המִתְלַקְּטִים</he> those coins which have been picked up singly, opp. <he>הנבללין</he>.—
<cite ref="Chullin 46a:10">Ḥull. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>מִתְלַקֵּט מהו</he> if the required size of sound flesh can be obtained only by collecting (it not being in one place), how is it?—
<cite ref="Chullin 77a:7">Ib. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>מתל׳ מהו</he> how is it, if the quantity of flesh required to cover the broken bone is scattered?
